instances.text: We hypothesize that global rewriting under limited post-drift evidence causes the LLM to inadvertently modify rules that remain effective for stable templates, introducing regressions that offset gains on drifted templates.
instances.source_text: The intuitive response—regenerating all rules from post-drift examples—surprisingly underperforms, as limited post-drift evidence causes the LLM to inadvertently modify rules that remain effective for stable templates.

instances.text: We propose Patch, a conservative update policy that generates a small set of delta rules targeting drifted patterns and prepends them to the unchanged original repository.
instances.source_text: We propose Patch, a conservative update policy that generates a small set of delta rules targeting drifted patterns and prepends them to the unchanged original repository.

instances.text: On a synthetic drift benchmark, Patch achieves 0.2742 overall FGA, outperforming Rewrite by +8.1 percentage points, with the largest gains on drifted templates (+14.1 points) while also improving stable-template performance (+5.5 points).
instances.source_text: On a synthetic drift benchmark, Patch achieves 0.2742 overall FGA, outperforming Rewrite by +8.1 percentage points.

instances.text: Recent advances in large language models have enabled a new paradigm for log parsing that leverages the semantic understanding capabilities of LLMs.
instances.source_text: Recent advances in large language models have enabled a new paradigm for log parsing.

instances.text: We addressed the rule repository update problem for LogRules-style LLM log parsers under template drift.
instances.source_text: • We identify the rule repository update problem for LogRules-style LLM log parsers and show that naive rewriting underperforms conservative patching. • We propose Patch, which generates targeted delta rules and prepends them to the unchanged original repository, achieving +8.1 FGA improvement over Rewrite. • We analyze why Patch succeeds: it decouples drift adaptation from stable-template handling, preserving pre-drift knowledge while adding targeted capacity for new patterns.

instances.why: Cites one work and relates it to nothing else.

instances.why: Cites one work and relates it to nothing else.

instances.text: LogBatcher [cite] addressed the efficiency challenge by clustering logs into partitions and batching queries to reduce LLM invocations while maintaining parsing accuracy.

instances.why: Cites one work and relates it to nothing else.
